Onboarding clients, suppliers or staff requires sanctions, political-exposure and ownership checks a regulator accepts.

Match names in three bands: a confident match is reported, a near-miss goes to a human, below that nothing is raised; walk ownership to the ultimate owner; never show a failed screen as a clean one.

It draws on these skills: [Sanctions and PEP screening](@/skills/sanctions-screening.md), [Ownership and link analysis](@/skills/ownership-analysis.md), [Entity resolution](@/skills/entity-resolution.md), [Risk scoring](@/skills/risk-scoring.md), [Contestable decisions](@/skills/contestable-decisions.md) and [Regulatory compliance mapping](@/skills/compliance-mapping.md).

It is built with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [PostgreSQL](@/glossary/postgresql.md) and [OpenAPI](@/glossary/openapi.md).

The technologies behind it, measured from the work that shows those skills: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md), [Majordomus](@/glossary/majordomus.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md) and [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md).

1 public repository shows its skills (1 by its own words).

It was delivered in client work under confidentiality agreements, in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group, as Architect, Lead engineer, AI engineer, Data engineer, Investigator and Advisor; the use cases describe the principle and the intent, never a client, person, date or number.

How to read this page: the method and the use cases are written by me; the skills, technologies and public evidence are derived from measured data and link to their own pages, each a [repository](@/glossary/repository.md), a term or a skill.
